title: Shazam
description: Shazam is a music discovery brand whose palette includes bright blue (#0088ff), bright oranges (#ffaa00, #ff7700), bright red (#ff0033), magenta (#9911aa), pink (#cc2288), lime (#aadd22), charcoal (#242424), gray (#646464), medium gray (#949494), and off-whites (#e4e4e4, #f4f4f4).
